root_cause.text: `led_classdev_register_ext` adds the LED device to the global `leds_list` before calling `led_init_core()`, creating a race condition where concurrent trigger registration can attempt to queue the uninitialized `set_brightness_work` work structure.
root_cause.evidence: The patch diff moves the `list_add_tail(&led_cdev->node, &leds_list)` block to execute after `led_init_core(led_cdev)` in `led_classdev_register_ext()`, preventing other threads from accessing the LED via `leds_list` before its workqueue structures are initialized.
